name: Golf ball
summary: White dimpled golf ball, optionally resting on a wooden tee; can bounce or spin. A small hero prop.

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the ball (or tee) rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 220 px across, with the tee about 330 px tall (hero size)

params.name: tee
params.note: true = the ball sits on a wooden tee; false = the ball sits on the ground

params.name: anim
params.note: bounce = hops on the spot; spin = turns, dimples and all

author: krakujs
